fact: The National Assembly approved on 31 July 2026 and the President promulgated on 7 September 2026 a law authorising the President to legislate the legal regime for electronic signatures and digital certification, including the accrediting authority and certification entities.
title: Lei de Autorização Legislativa n.º 12/26 – Regime Jurídico da Assinatura Electrónica e da Certificação Digital
publisher: Assembleia Nacional / Presidente da República de Angola (via Angolex)
